# Slow fixture identities

These six files are copied byte for byte from [`ethereum/legacytests` at `1f581b8ccdc4c63acf5f2c5c1b155c690c32a8eb`](https://github.com/ethereum/legacytests/tree/1f581b8ccdc4c63acf5f2c5c1b155c690c32a8eb), with their upstream paths retained.
They cover the four slow state-test names the reference runner skips, including the two older Constantinople variants.
They are test data for the content-hash skip policy, not execution inputs to the Satin gate.
Keep their original bytes: formatting them changes the identities being tested.
